colourings.label: Capture exposure
colourings.note: The composite: capture capacity multiplied by drug-market intensity, geometric mean. High only where a state is both penetrable and worth penetrating.

colourings.label: State-embedded actors
colourings.note: GI-TOC's measure of officials, security personnel and others using state power for illicit advantage. All organised crime, not drugs alone.

colourings.label: Drug-market intensity
colourings.note: The highest of the four drug indicators — cocaine, synthetics, heroin, cannabis. Whether the country sits inside a major drug economy at all.

colourings.label: Exposure (mean-based)
colourings.note: The same composite computed against the mean of all four drug markets rather than the peak. Countries with one large market and three small ones fall; broad-market countries hold.

colourings.label: Drug intensity (mean)
colourings.note: Mean of the four drug indicators — breadth of the drug economy rather than its peak.

colourings.label: Resilience (inverted: darker is weaker)
colourings.note: GI-TOC's resilience score: judiciary, law enforcement, transparency, anti-money-laundering. Inverted on the map — darker means weaker.
